preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of businesses N must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 1000000000 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each business value A[i] must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The sum of N over all test cases must not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible damage as a string.
